summary: Implemented all six plan phases: an opt-in --only SUITE[,SUITE,...] flag in run-all.sh (single filtering site, validate-all-tokens-first), a new sourced-only scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh mapping library (three-strata touched-file -> suite resolution with a fail-safe full-sweep sentinel and advisory resolution-order classification), a 15-case regression suite plus its manifest.json registration, and documentation in shell-script-testing.md. Proved the strict-subset property and a measured ~49% wall-clock reduction for a representative selection against the real battery (123 suites) under this session's heavy concurrent-sibling host load (uptime 3.99-12.90), with an honest caveat that the corpus's single most expensive suite dominated the selected run's cost. Gate 8's own full sweep is unchanged by default.

artifacts.summary: Full implementation summary: what changed, decisions, plan deviations, measured figures with load conditions, and follow-ups.
New sourced-only library mapping touched source paths to resolved suite names.
New 15-case regression suite covering both the mapping library and the --only flag.
